== Biography ==

== Trivia ==
* Became the youngest botlaner to win a [[LCK/2023 Season/Spring Playoffs|LCK title]] at the age of 17
* Part of a select group of players called "Royal Roaders", earned after winning their rookie split in a major region (LCK Spring 2023)
* With 234 kills in [[LCK 2023 Summer]], he was the player with the most kills in one LCK's split, beating the previous record of 219 kills set by [[Gumayusi]] in [[LCK 2022 Spring]] before [[Aiming]] claimed that record a year later
* Currently holds the record for highest number of kills in a single match at an international LoL event after achieving 28 kills in [[MSI 2024|MSI 2024 Finals Game 2]], the same game in which he got a pentakill as {{ci|Kalista}}.<ref>[https://www.strafe.com/news/read/peyz-sets-a-new-28-kill-record-at-msi/ Peyz Sets a New 28 Kill Record at MSI Grand Finals] ''strafe.com''</ref>
* He is the player with the most recorded number of pentakills in professional play (16) and also the player with the most used champions for pentakills (10).

=== Statistics ===
* Reached 1000 kills in the LCK on August 3rd, 2024.
** Was the 27th player to reach 1000 kills in the LCK.
** Was the first LCK player ([[Faker]] was fastest before with 207 games) and the first major league player since Deft in LPL 2016 to reach this milestone in less than 200 games.

=== Individual Awards ===
* LCK Finals MVP x1 (Spring 2023)
* LCK Player of the Split x1 (Summer 2024)
* LCK Rookie of the Year x1 (2023)
* LCK 1st All-Pro Team x2 (Spring 2024, Summer 2024)
* LCK 2nd All-Pro Team x1 (Summer 2023)
* LCK 3rd All-Pro Team x1 (Spring 2023)
* LPL 2nd All-Pro Team x1 (Split 2 2025)
* LPL 3rd All-Pro Team x1 (Split 1 2025)
* KeSPA Cup Finals MVP (2025)
* LCK CL Best ADC (Summer 2022)
